title: Rotary knob
description: What the knob controls and how. Light channel changes apply after a restart, everything else at once.

keys.name: allow_control
keys.title: Allow control
keys.description: Autopilot and anchor commands leave the knob only while this is on. Off on a fresh knob and after a factory reset. Switching it on here shows CONTROL ON on the knob.

keys.name: autopilot_id
keys.title: Autopilot id
keys.description: The autopilot in the SignalK v2 autopilot API, the id after /autopilots/ (not _default on this boat).

keys.name: heading_source
keys.title: Heading source
keys.description: navigation.headingTrue (shown as degrees true) or navigation.headingMagnetic (degrees magnetic).

keys.name: anchor_radius
keys.title: Default anchor radius
keys.description: The watch circle radius used when arming, until the dial changes it.

keys.name: dim_after_s
keys.title: Dim after idle
keys.description: Seconds without input before the backlight drops to the dim level.

keys.name: dim_level_pct
keys.title: Dim level
keys.description: Backlight when dimmed. 10 % can be hard to read in direct sun.

keys.name: off_after_min
keys.title: Backlight off after idle
keys.description: Minutes of idle before the backlight goes fully off, except while the autopilot is engaged or an alarm is active. 0 = never.

keys.name: brightness_pct
keys.title: Active brightness
keys.description: Backlight while in use. The knob's settings screen changes it too.

keys.name: night_mode
keys.title: Night mode
keys.description: server = follow environment.mode from SignalK, day or night = fixed. The serial command n overrides it until the next restart.

keys.name: leds_on
keys.title: LEDs
keys.description: Off = every LED stays dark in every mode, the alarm flash included: an alarm then shows on the screen only.

keys.name: hid_profile
keys.title: USB-HID profile
keys.description: What the dial does in the USB-HID mode: chartplotter (mouse wheel and click), media (volume and mute) or nav (arrow keys and enter).

keys.name: light1_name
keys.title: Light 1 name
keys.description: Shown on the knob, upper case, up to 15 characters.

keys.name: light1_path
keys.title: Light 1 SignalK path
keys.description: Empty = channel not used. A relay path takes 1 or 0, a dimmer path a ratio 0 to 1.

keys.name: light1_form
keys.title: Light 1 type
keys.description: onoff = a relay (turn right is on, left is off). level = a dimmer.
